messages:
jamie: FYI - we're seeing a spike in auth errors from EU1. I'm going to pause any in-flight releases for the next 30m unless ops says otherwise.

deploy-bot: Automatic action: pausing all active release slots in eu-region due to incident #INC-2026-045. Affected: canary and staggered rollouts. Commands: `/deploy resume <id>` or `/deploy reschedule <id> --at <time>`.

anya: Thanks @jamie. Oncall Matt is looking. Matt, can you confirm service impact and ETA?

matt: looking. Auth error rate x5 for token validation. Severity medium-high. Rolling back a recent config push now. ETA 20-40m to stabilize.

kevin: product note — we have scheduled v2.3.1 canary to reach 10% in 45m. We should pin versions and avoid automatic ramp until this is cleared.

sarah: I'm release owner for v2.3.1. Agree pin and hold. Please don't auto-retry canaries. I'll update release notes and changelog to note the hold.

jamie: ok; propose reschedule window tomorrow 02:00 UTC if stable. If we resume earlier we'll announce.

matt: current plan: revert config, watch 15m after revert. If error rate back to baseline mark stable.

ops-bot: Action recorded: release-holds set on releases [v2.3.1-canary, v2.3.1-staggered]. Owner=sarah. Follow-up: `/ops checklist`

jamie: can we do a soft rollback to previous model version for inference path? that would reduce load on auth service.

kevin: that would change behavioral surface. prefer config rollback. Sarah, can you confirm you don't want model roll back?

sarah: don't change model. config rollback only. We'll re-run canary after confirmation from Matt + Jamie.

anya: adding note for later — update runbook entry `deploy-hold-on-incident` with step to notify product and set `auto_resume=false`.

jamie: thanks. I'll pin release to 2.3.1@2026-03-20-02:00UTC and create a reschedule PR for the release calendar.

matt: revert complete. observing metric: error rate back to 1.1x baseline after 10m. continuing to monitor.

jamie: awesome. Sarah, once Matt gives explicit stable, do you want manual resume or auto?

sarah: manual resume please. I'll do a quick smoke and then `/deploy resume v2.3.1`.

matt: agree. marking stable at 3112345900.

jamie: ok reschedule target remains 2026-03-20T02:00Z unless earlier resume. I'll update release notes and post in #general when resumed. :white_check_mark:
